entries.note: The development build selects its existing system Node executable explicitly for the native bootstrap bridge. CMake still verifies/fetches the pinned libcurl archive on first configure and requires the exact SDL2 prerequisite; no Electron or browser bundle is built. An exclusive build lock prevents cooperating launch/update builders from writing the same archive or executable concurrently. Only a proven dead PID releases stale ownership; a live or malformed lock times out visibly. Building alone never starts workspace services or a game.
